item.title: Namib Minerals Secures US$6.5 Million Term Loan Facility to Partially Fund Resource Definition and Bankability
item.description: New York, Sept. 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Namib Minerals (’Namib’ or ’the Company’) (Nasdaq: NAMM), today announced that Bulawayo Mining Company (Private) Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, has secured a non-dilutive new term loan facility for US$ 6.5 million (the ’New Term Loan Facility”) with African Banking Corporation of Zimbabwe Limited (’BancABC”). The New Term Loan Facility is in addition to the Company’s existing term loan and overdraft facilities with BancABC, with all such facilities consolidated into a single facility (the ’Facility”). The Facility strengthens the Company’s liquidity and working capital position with the funds from the New Term Loan Facility earmarked for utilisation towards Step 3 of the Company’s Development Timelines and Milestones for Redwing Mine previously announced in July 2026 (the ’Development Milestones”). (via manilatimes.net) #Zimbabwe #ZimbabweNews
